status: EXAMPLE ONLY: conceptual animation, not a claim about implemented RobloxLARP protection features

scenes.visual_cause: A visible attempt to pull a copy away from its source creates immediate tension
scenes.primary_action: The source panel bends and splits at a point of contact while a copy peels away
scenes.secondary_reaction: Adjacent status strokes warp toward the extraction and the virtual camera reframes its focal point
scenes.result: The viewer sees an incomplete detached copy and a continuing line of tension
scenes.text_role: A small caption reveals the stakes after the split; the image is intelligible without it

handoff.forward_action: The extraction line stretches beyond the panel edge, enters foreground and masks the next environment

scenes.visual_cause: The stretched extraction line closes into the contour of a generic access gate
scenes.primary_action: The line physically folds into a gate; the detached copy tries to pass through
scenes.secondary_reaction: A nearby control retracts after contact; the surroundings shift with a delayed parallax response
scenes.result: The detached copy is redirected and the empty gate outline becomes a new shape
scenes.text_role: Minimal short label appears beside the reacting control rather than replacing the scene

handoff.forward_action: The gate outline expands into a full-screen contour before a new scene is revealed

scenes.visual_cause: The gate outline becomes the edge of a new workspace rather than an unrelated fresh slide
scenes.primary_action: Multiple related lines connect into a legible flow while the camera settles on the result
scenes.secondary_reaction: A compact status button updates only after the flow completes; secondary lines settle at a different speed
scenes.result: The scene resolves into one clear outcome with a natural audio tail
scenes.text_role: A short payoff accompanies the established animation instead of explaining an otherwise static poster
